```{python}
#| include: false

import pandas as pd
# from datetime import datetime
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from MyCustomLibrary.data import BTC_Daily
price = (BTC_Daily.droplevel(0, axis=1).loc[:,'Close']).copy()

# _today_str = datetime.today()
_today_str = price.index[-1].strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
_AnnotationText = f" | Updated: {_today_str}"
# _AnnotationText = f" | Updated: {_today_str} | Price: {round(price.iloc[-1])}"

desired_rows = 225*7
```


````{python}
#| include: false

def plot_comparative_graph(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    title:str='Performance Analysis',
    x_axis_title:str='Days',
    y_axis_title:str='ROI - log scale',
    y_log_scale: bool=True,
    watermark: bool=True
    ):

    # Fazer com que as séries temporais comecem do mesmo ponto
    rebased_equities = (df / df.iloc[0]) * 100

    cycles_compare = go.Figure()
    # Iterate over the tickers list
    for column in df.columns:
        cycles_compare.add_trace(go.Scatter(name=f'{column}', x=df.index, y=rebased_equities[column]))

    if watermark:
        # Add watermark as text
        cycles_compare.add_annotation(
            x=0.5,
            y=0.5,
            textangle=0,
            opacity=0.1,
            text="Rui Caseiro",
            showarrow=False,
            font=dict(family="Arial", size=80, color="white"),
            xref="paper",
            yref="paper"
        )

    if y_log_scale:
        cycles_compare.update_yaxes(type='log')

    # Acrescentar tema
    cycles_compare.update_layout(
        template='plotly_dark',
        hovermode="x unified",
        title=dict(text=title, x=0.5, xanchor="center", y=0.95, yanchor="top",font=dict(size=16)),
        margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=50, b=50),
        showlegend=False,
        # legend=dict(orientation="h", x=0.5, xanchor="center", y=-0.2, yanchor="bottom", font=dict(size=10)),
        xaxis=dict(title=x_axis_title, showgrid=False, zeroline=False, showline=False),
        yaxis=dict(title=y_axis_title, showgrid=False, zeroline=False, showline=False, ticksuffix=' %')
    )
    
    cycles_compare.show()

````


# Bitcoin Cycles


## Row 1 {height=50%}
```{python}

## Definicao das datas dos tops de cada ciclo
top13 = "2013-11-30"
top17 = "2017-12-17"
top21 = "2021-11-10"
top25 = "2025-10-06"

# Criação do DataFrame de ciclos com colunas ajustadas
top_cycles = pd.DataFrame()
top_cycles['cycle1'] = price.loc[:top13].reset_index(drop=True).reindex(range(desired_rows))
top_cycles['cycle2'] = price.loc[top13:top17].reset_index(drop=True).reindex(range(desired_rows))
top_cycles['cycle3'] = price.loc[top17:top21].reset_index(drop=True).reindex(range(desired_rows))
top_cycles['cycle4'] = price.loc[top21:top25].reset_index(drop=True).reindex(range(desired_rows))
top_cycles['cycle5'] = price.loc[top25:].reset_index(drop=True).reindex(range(desired_rows))

plot_comparative_graph(
    top_cycles, 
    title=f'Bitcoin Top to Top Cycles {_AnnotationText}', 
    x_axis_title='Days since Top'
)

```
